policy: Shared set/material frame and paper HSB; frozen per-scan frame pose; disjoint UUID cohorts; minimum 3+3; held-out median regression <=0.15 Oklab, worst per-card <=2, clipping <=3%; preserve prior approved median within 0.25. Texture/shadow residuals remain explicit diagnostics, not a claim of texture equality. Additional independent component gates: median color error <=5; dark-bin chroma/lightness must not regress >0.25 Oklab and texture contrast-error must not regress >0.5. Absolute texture residuals remain asset diagnostics.
